Module net.automatalib.serialization.saf
Package net.automatalib.serialization.saf

Class SAFParsers

java.lang.Object
net.automatalib.serialization.saf.SAFParsers
public final class SAFParsers extends Object
Facade for SAF (simple automaton format) parsing. This class provides several static methods to access InputModelDeserializers for SAF descriptions of DFAs, MealyMachines, and NFAs.
